subject: Do not adopt the MYSELF flag from a gossip entry (#5134)
reason: The fix strips CLUSTER_NODE_MYSELF when creating a node from a gossip entry in clusterProcessGossipSection. That path fires only when a cluster-bus gossip entry about an unknown node carries the MYSELF flag, which a conforming Valkey never emits (clusterSetGossipEntry copies a node's own flags and the send loop skips myself); it is reachable only by injecting a hand-crafted binary packet to the cluster-bus port, as the maintainers' own packet.tcl test does with a raw socket. No installed component speaks the binary cluster-bus protocol or can address the bus port: valkey.action.commands raw by
